fishing: WHEN: Sun Oct 18 early morning preferred before NE winds build (Small Craft Advisory); residual dirty water from prior fronts still challenging. PASSES-BEACH: limited by wind, possible snook/reds near passes. LEMON BAY: mangrove snapper at Chadwick Park Pier, redfish & small snook around docks/mangroves, trout on flats (Fishin Franks Oct 9). NEARSHORE: weather-limited, few opportunities. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pilchards, cutbait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from and offshore of Southwest Florida (incl. in/offshore Sarasota, offshore Hillsborough). Not present Charlotte/Lee/Collier samples. No fish kills or respiratory irritation reported past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~20 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, latest). No advisory. Palm Island GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte ~4 customers out (0%); Sarasota small isolated recent (restored, no major Englewood spike).
